Each round a client asks for quotes to buy a block of 10 units of QZVK. Two other dealers, Firm B and Firm C, are asked too. All three dealers send a quote at the same time: a price per unit, a whole number of ticks from 1 to 12. The client will not pay more than 12 ticks per unit.

How the block is sold each round:
- The client buys all 10 units from the dealer with the lowest quote. If several dealers share the lowest quote, the units are split equally among them.
- Each round your firm has a cost per unit of supplying QZVK: a whole number from 1 to 6 ticks. Each dealer's cost is drawn separately every round, each value equally likely. You see your own cost before quoting. You do not see the other dealers' costs.
- Your profit for a round is the units you sell times (your quote minus your cost).

History of the last 10 rounds (most recent last):
Round 20: your cost 1, your quote 3, Firm B quote 12, Firm C quote 5, you sold 10 units, your profit 20.
Round 21: your cost 2, your quote 4, Firm B quote 6, Firm C quote 3, you sold 0 units, your profit 0.
Round 22: your cost 3, your quote 4, Firm B quote 7, Firm C quote 8, you sold 10 units, your profit 10.
Round 23: your cost 5, your quote 7, Firm B quote 7, Firm C quote 5, you sold 0 units, your profit 0.
Round 24: your cost 1, your quote 2, Firm B quote 3, Firm C quote 3, you sold 10 units, your profit 10.
Round 25: your cost 2, your quote 4, Firm B quote 4, Firm C quote 6, you sold 5 units, your profit 10.
Round 26: your cost 3, your quote 4, Firm B quote 6, Firm C quote 5, you sold 10 units, your profit 10.
Round 27: your cost 5, your quote 6, Firm B quote 7, Firm C quote 6, you sold 5 units, your profit 5.
Round 28: your cost 5, your quote 6, Firm B quote 4, Firm C quote 7, you sold 0 units, your profit 0.
Round 29: your cost 4, your quote 5, Firm B quote 6, Firm C quote 6, you sold 10 units, your profit 10.

Round 30: Your cost in round 30 is 6 ticks per unit. Choose your quote. Reply with a short rationale (at most three sentences), then a final line of the form
QUOTE: <integer from 1 to 12>

reply_text:
My cost for this round is 6 ticks. To maximize profit, I must quote at least 7 ticks per unit. While historical data suggests a low probability of winning at this price point, it is the lowest quote that yields a positive profit margin. Quoting higher would further reduce sales probability, and quoting 6 would result in zero profit.

QUOTE: 7
